children.name: Cancelling an RTP - EPC v4 mock unhappy path scenario: cncl_extra_field
parameters: 'An EPC response containing fields not declared in the OpenAPI spec is treated as an invalid message and is NOT tolerated for accept/reject purposes (confirmed with rtp-sender-v2 maintainers, PR #26).
